newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Arm Financial Q2 turns in loss.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Arm Financial Q2 turns in loss.

text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended
(In thousands, except per share amounts and where noted)

NOTE: -- Company completed initial public offering in Q2 raising $79 million. For comparison, company reporting pro forma results to adjust for the impact of the ipo as if it had occured at the begining of each period.
-- Q2 1997 includes one-time, non-cash stock based

compensation charge as result of ipo of $8.1 million and non-recurring charges of $1.2 million, mainly relating to the previously announced relocation and consolidation of the company's operations facilities from Columbus, Ohio to Louisville, Kentucky. As a result, the Company incurred a net loss applicable to common shareholders of $1.0 million for the quarter, or 6 cents per share. For the first six months of 1997, the net income applicable to common shareholders was $5.4 million, or 30 cents per share. This compares to 1996 second quarter net income applicable to common shareholders of $4.8 million, 28 cents per share and 1996 first six months of $8.1 million, 46 cents per share.
-- (A) pro forma operating earnings is defined as net

income applicable to common shareholders, excluding, net of tax, realized investment gains and losses, non-recurring charges and income from defined benefit pension plan asset management operations which are being sold and includes the net pro forma effect on earnings assuming the Company's initial public offering of common stock had occurred at the beginning of each period presented.
-- (B) New assets under management accepted both on
and off the Company's balance sheet.
